latest_cos_commentary.headline: heytruffle (formerly RestoHost) is a newly rebranded, Preface Ventures-backed managed AI phone-concierge service for multi-location restaurant groups, handling reservations, orders, and catering inquiries by phone.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Adjacent to Genius's loyalty_engagement line as a guest-communications/engagement point solution rather than a POS or payments competitor; it does not process payments or run a POS.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Just rebranded and raised new funding (July 2026), signaling an active nationwide expansion push under the new heytruffle name and managed-service positioning.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Relevant mainly as a point-solution a restaurant group might already use for phone/reservation handling alongside its POS and payments stack; not a substitute for core POS/payments infrastructure.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Funding amount is undisclosed; only one named customer reference (Rreal Tacos) is publicly available, so broader market traction is unverified.
